messages:
deepak-recruiter: Heads up — candidate offer (Sofia M) was created on EU band while she just accepted an internal move to SF. She needs US comp band + prorated sign-on. Candidate can start 4/11 if we move fast. Can we approve an exception?

maria-peopleops: Thanks for flagging. Do you have the offer numbers (base / bonus / equity) and the new target band in the US? Also any visa or notice constraints?

deepak-recruiter: Current EU offer: €85k base + 10% bonus + 6k EUR sign-on + 0.2% eq (4y). US target band (IC3): $150k base target, 10% bonus, equity ~0.2%. She has 2 weeks notice but is willing to start earlier if we expedite. No visa — she's US resident now.

lisa-comp: Got it. Main ask: uplift base from EU equiv to US band and convert sign-on to gross USD prorated for start date. Preliminary conversion I ran: 
```
EUR85k -> ~USD92k (market adj)
We need to fill to band median $150k => uplift ~$58k
Sign-on conversion: 6k EUR ~ $6.5k, prorate for 4/11 start (~75% of month) => ~$4.9k
Suggested one-time sign-on to bridge: $25k to make total cash competitive (base+sign-on) while keeping equity unchanged.
```
Proposal: base -> $145k, sign-on one-time $25k, bonus 10%, equity 0.2%. This would still be slightly under median but within hiring manager approval range.

jon-hiring-manager: I can stretch to $150k base but prefer $145k + $35k sign-on to preserve cashflow. We need her onboard 4/11 to cover the payments sprint. Budget for IC3 is flexible up to $185k OTE. If comp approves, I can sign off. :thumbsup:

maria-peopleops: Two approvals needed: comp (lisa) and ops committee for cross-region proration/exception. Lisa — is $145k+$35k sign-on okay from comp policy perspective? If not, what's the minimum we can fast-track?

lisa-comp: $145k base + $35k sign-on is fine as an exception under the relocation clause — we just need exec ratification because total first-year cash > band threshold. I can prepare the exception memo. Need final breakdown and rationale bullet points (market + start date risk).

paul-cto: +1 from me given hiring urgency and impact on roadmap. Please include the hiring manager note about sprint coverage. I can approve exec ratification for this hire. :eyes:

maria-peopleops: Great — I'll fast-track to the committee and attach lisa's memo + jon's note. Routing: people-ops -> comp -> COO exec sign-off. Aiming for decision by EOD today to meet 4/11.

deepak-recruiter: Amazing — I'll tell Sofia we're working on fast-track and tentatively hold 4/11. Will confirm when you post final. Thanks everyone! :pray:

maria-peopleops: Filed as emergency routing 1864123456-EFAST in the internal tracker. If approved, I'll update the offer and trigger DocuSign. Will also note prorated start month sign-on calc.

lisa-comp: I'll attach the calc and policy excerpt. Final ask: please confirm timezone for sigma sign-off meeting. I can be available 2pm PT today.

jon-hiring-manager: 2pm PT works. I'll be there and present the business urgency.

maria-peopleops: Closing loop — committee meeting scheduled 14:00 PT. If approved, sign-off + docs by 18:00 PT, candidate notified same day. :thumbsup:

deepak-recruiter: Perfect — thanks all.
